description: This Java class 'TestConfig' provides centralized configuration utilities for API testing, reading configuration values from JVM properties, environment variables, a .env file, and defaults, for the OrangeHRM demo API testing framework.

classes.name: TestConfig
classes.description: A utility class for managing configuration settings for API tests, including default values and environment overrides.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration value by key, checking system properties, the dotenv file, environment variables, and falling back to a default value.

methods.name: baseUrl
methods.description: Returns the base URL for API testing, defaulting to the OrangeHRM demo site.

methods.name: apiBasePath
methods.description: Returns the API base path, defaulting to '/api/v2'.

methods.name: adminUsername
methods.description: Provides the default admin username for the demo environment.

methods.name: adminPassword
methods.description: Provides the default admin password for the demo environment.

methods.name: essUsername
methods.description: Provides the default ESS user username.

methods.name: essPassword
methods.description: Provides the default ESS user password.
